name: Enrich and Notify on Wazuh Critical Alert
description: Triggered on TheHive case creation. Extracts the source IP observable, runs it through Cortex's AbuseIPDB analyzer, tags the case if malicious, and sends a notification.

actions.name: Extract observable
actions.description: Extract the source IP observable from the newly created TheHive case

actions.name: Cortex AbuseIPDB lookup
actions.description: Call Cortex's AbuseIPDB analyzer via Cortex's REST API against the extracted IP

actions.name: Conditional tag
actions.description: If the AbuseIPDB reputation score exceeds the configured threshold, add tag 'confirmed-malicious' to the TheHive case

actions.name: Notify
actions.description: Send a notification (Discord/Slack webhook, or a local log write as the simplest option) summarizing the case and enrichment result
